name: witch-hat
draw: Wide-brimmed tall pointed hat with a bent tip and a buckled band.

name: flying-witch
draw: Silhouette of a witch in a pointed hat riding a broomstick across a crescent moon.

name: wizard-staff
draw: Tall gnarled wooden staff with twisted branches at the top holding a round glowing orb.

name: mandrake
draw: Root plant pulled from the ground with a leafy top and a forked root shaped like a small screaming figure.

name: magic-circle
draw: Double circle with a triangle inscribed inside and small rune marks spaced around the ring.

name: alchemy-symbol
draw: Circle inside a triangle inside a square inside a larger circle, the squared circle alchemy emblem.

name: alembic
draw: Glass still with a round flask, a domed head and a long spout angled down to a small receiving flask.

name: crystal-skull
draw: Front view of a skull made of clear faceted crystal with a highlight and angular facets.

name: crystal-pendulum
draw: Pointed six-sided crystal hanging from a thin chain held by two fingers, swinging with a small arc line.

name: dowsing-rod
draw: Y-shaped forked stick held by two hands with the single tip pointing down to wavy lines of water.

name: palm-reading
draw: Open palm facing forward with curved heart, head and life lines drawn across it.

name: magic-mirror
draw: Oval ornate framed wall mirror with a face shown in the glass and small sparkles.

name: wishing-well
draw: Round stone well with a small peaked roof, a crank and a hanging bucket.

name: fairy-house
draw: Mushroom-cap roof over a small round house with a tiny door and a window in the stalk.

name: magic-portal
draw: Upright oval doorway filled with a swirling spiral and small sparkles around its rim.

name: enchanted-rose
draw: Single rose with a drooping petal under a tall glass bell dome on a round base.

name: glass-slipper
draw: Side view of a delicate high-heeled shoe with facet lines and a small sparkle.

name: magic-beanstalk
draw: Tall twisting bean vine with large leaves climbing up into a cloud.

name: poison-apple
draw: Apple with one bite taken out and a skull mark on its skin.

name: pumpkin-carriage
draw: Pumpkin-shaped coach with a door and window, curly trim and two spoked wheels.

name: frog-prince
draw: Sitting frog wearing a small crown on its head.

name: princess-and-the-pea
draw: Tall stack of mattresses on a bed frame with a single small pea at the very bottom.

name: golden-goose
draw: Side view of a goose standing over a shiny egg with sparkle marks.

name: man-in-the-moon
draw: Crescent moon with a face in profile on its inner curve, a closed eye and a nose.

name: wizard-tower
draw: Tall slim round stone tower with a pointed conical roof, a star flag and one high window.

name: floating-island
draw: Chunk of earth hovering in the air with grass and a tree on top and dangling roots and rocks below.

name: atlantis
draw: Domed city of columns and towers sitting on the sea floor with bubbles rising and wave lines above.

name: poison-bottle
draw: Small corked bottle with a skull and crossbones label and a drip running down the side.

name: treasure-hoard
draw: Heap of gold coins piled into a mound with a goblet and gems poking out of it.

name: invisibility-cloak
draw: Hooded cloak standing upright with an empty dark opening where the face should be and a dashed outline at the hem.

name: spell-cast
draw: Open hand with fingers spread and swirling sparkles and a small star spiraling out from the palm.

name: ouroboros
draw: Snake forming a circle while biting its own tail.

name: horseshoe
draw: U-shaped horseshoe with open end up and a row of nail holes along both arms.
